<!--
How Upptime reads the block above (it only reads the first comment of this issue):
- start and end in ISO 8601 with the offset to UTC: +02:00 in summer time, +01:00 in winter time, or Z for UTC.
  Zone names like "Europe/Berlin" make the time invalid, and Upptime then never closes the issue.
  Without an offset the monitor reads UTC, but the status page reads the visitor's local time.
- expectedDown and expectedDegraded take the slugs of the checks, separated by commas (currently only feiert-ag).
  During the window Upptime opens no incident for them. Leave the lines out if nothing is expected to fail.
- After the end Upptime closes and locks this issue by itself.
- Only for real work windows. Permanent notes belong in introMessage in .upptimerc.yml.
-->
